description: Chalmers University of Technology: volcanic hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Chalmers University of Technology. Coverage: Chalmers University of Technology. The listing groups 31 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about volcanic hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: SO2 flux of COPAHUE volcano, from the NOVAC data-base; SO2 flux of TURRIALBA volcano, from the NOVAC data-base; SO2 flux of the ARENAL volcano, from the NOVAC data-base; SO2 flux of NEVADO.DEL.RUIZ volcano, from the NOVAC data-base. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
